constraints: Keep provider.runtime, Globals.Function.Runtime, per-function Runtime, and Terraform aws_lambda_function.runtime on one AWS Lambda runtime identifier that AWS still supports.
Raising the managed runtime can require Python language and dependency changes; confirm handlers and native modules run on the replacement before deploying.

steps.instructions: Change the reported Runtime (or provider.runtime / terraform runtime) from python3.6 to a supported AWS Lambda Python identifier (see the replacement).
steps.title: Raise the AWS Lambda runtime

steps.instructions: Update every other SAM/CloudFormation Globals or function Runtime, serverless.yml provider or function runtime, Terraform aws_lambda_function.runtime, and CI deploy config that still pins python3.6.
steps.title: Align other runtime surfaces

verification.command: sam validate || serverless print || terraform validate
verification.purpose: Validate the updated SAM, Serverless Framework, or Terraform declaration before deploy.

rule.summary: The AWS Lambda runtimes table lists python3.6 under Deprecated runtimes with deprecation date 2022-07-18. AWS no longer applies security or other updates to that managed runtime.
rule.title: AWS Lambda Python 3.6 runtime is end-of-life
